verdict.rationale: Evidence only shows Dagster exposing itself as an MCP server for AI agents to control Dagster+ (dagster-docs-14) and offering AI skills for coding agents to write Dagster code (dagster-docs-13/34) — i.e., Dagster is the server/target, not a client consuming external MCP servers' tools. There is no evidence that Dagster can plug in third-party MCP servers to use their tools within its own pipelines or workflows.
